components.description: High-visibility action button for primary conversions and lab launches.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7 0%, #06b6d4 100%); color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3); transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.45); }

rules.name: The Rarity of Glow Rule
rules.body: Saturated glowing accents carry active controls and focal headlines, occupying ≤12% of the viewport.

rules.name: The Zero-Gradient Text Rule
rules.body: Text emphasis is communicated through size, font weight, and solid high-contrast accents, never decorative gradient text masks.

dos: Do maintain high contrast ratios (≥4.5:1 for body copy and ≥3:1 for display headings).
Do test all animations against prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
donts: Don't use generic stock gradient text or unmotivated neon halos.
Don't add eyebrow kickers above headings; let the titles speak directly.
